hero.headline: Scaling Africa's Digital Frontier Together
hero.subheadline: We are seeking visionary partners to expand our 1MW footprint and build the pan-African compute backbone.

sections.title: An Ecosystem for Long-Term Value
sections.body: Kenya AI Compute is not a siloed project; it is a collaborative ecosystem designed to integrate local natural resources with global technological demand. We are actively expanding our network of strategic partners in three key areas: Energy, Technology, and Local Infrastructure. We offer our partners a unique entry point into the most innovative asset class in the East African market. Partners benefit from international currency revenue streams, technology transfer from global DC experts, and the opportunity to scale alongside us to 3MW and beyond. Whether you are a Kenyan construction firm, a global GPU vendor, or an institutional financier, we have a structured partnership model designed to align our long-term interests and maximize project ROI. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. sections.title: Partnership Pathways
items: Energy Partners: Help us build and scale hybrid generation assets.
Tech Partners: Design and optimize high-density compute environments.
Local Partners: Navigate the Kenyan regulatory and logistical landscape.
Network Partners: Integrate DePIN protocols and global IP transit.
Capital Partners: Participate in our Phase 2 and Phase 3 expansion rounds.
